title: Tuna Mayo

items.n: tuna, drained weight (canned in water or oil)

steps.x: Drain tuna thoroughly, pressing out liquid, then weigh out 450g. Excess liquid makes the filling watery.
Rinse diced red onion under cold water 30 sec, then pat dry. This takes the raw bite off, so it stays mild for the child's portion.
Flake tuna, then stir in mayonnaise, mustard, onion, salt and pepper. Chill 15 min, then taste and adjust mustard.

notes: Keeps 2 days chilled; best eaten sooner
Adult chilli: stir 0.5 tsp chilli flakes into your portion only
